about: A rewrite of the Linux access control list tools in Rust.

prs.title: getfacl names a missing file and keeps going
prs.broken: When one of several files couldn't be read, getfacl stopped there and printed an error without saying which file.
prs.changed: The error now names the file, and the remaining files are still listed. The exit code still reports the failure.
prs.matters: One bad path in a list no longer hides the results for every file after it.
